# Lifespan timeline of prime ministers of Romania__disambig_1

This is a graphical lifespan timeline of prime ministers of Romania.  The prime ministers are listed in order of office, with prime ministers that served multiple premierships shown in order of their first.
1859–1947
1947–1989
1989–present
